sources.label: Brooks and Lutz streetcar GIS
sources.status: Downloaded; attributes inspected; LARy subset converted
sources.use: Two independent vector starting layers. 59 LA records from the 1915 mixed file; 37 records from 193x-LArail.
sources.limits: Routes and branches are observations, not unique tracks. Not an all-time inventory; 193x exact snapshot is uncertain.

sources.label: Brooks and Lutz data appendix, printed pp. 69–70
sources.status: Downloaded, text inspected, relevant pages rendered and visually checked
sources.use: Identifies Gillespie’s 1915 LARy guide and an official map dated 1935 using Walker among the research sources.
sources.limits: The stated greatest-extent research goal does not establish a complete 1895–1963 physical-track inventory.

sources.label: Metro: Los Angeles Railway, 1900
sources.limits: Only 439×482 pixels; schematic reference, not precision tracing or complete early coverage.

sources.label: Library of Congress: city railway systems, 1906
sources.status: Catalog inspected; Metro smaller scan downloaded
sources.limits: Multiple operators. Include only demonstrably relevant LARy or subsequently acquired segments; confirm actual operation.

sources.label: Metro: Whitlock city streetcars and interurbans
sources.limits: Mixed operators; source date alone is not a complete ownership history.

sources.label: Huntington: LARy transportation / building-permit map series
sources.status: Catalog verified; sheets not individually audited
sources.limits: Permit year and base-network date can differ. The August 19, 1920 base is after the documented August 5 Echo Park abandonment.

sources.label: Metro: 1927 PE/LARy engineering map
sources.use: Detailed streets; legend distinguishes solid yellow LARy rail from dashed yellow motor coaches.
sources.limits: Needs georeferencing. Includes other operators and modes; cannot establish every temporary track or its exact dates.

sources.label: Metro: 1928 Los Angeles transit map
sources.use: Independent geographic comparison for late-1920s network.
sources.limits: Postdates some losses; annual date does not establish whether January 1928 abandonments are reflected.

sources.label: Huntington: official LARy route map, front and reverse
sources.use: Audit the 193x GIS, route descriptions and downtown geometry.
sources.limits: Includes buses. No individual feature-to-map reconciliation performed yet.

sources.label: Metro: LARy electric-car and bus routes
sources.use: Check later-1930s extensions and terminal changes.
sources.limits: Separate car lines from coach lines; precedes 1939 terminal additions.

sources.label: Metro: LARy rail and motorcoach map
sources.limits: Small scan; seek a higher-resolution copy for downtown and loop tracing.

sources.label: Metro: Los Angeles Transit Lines route map
sources.status: Download link verified in Metro directory; sheet not inspected
sources.limits: Do not classify motor coaches or trolleybuses as rail.

sources.label: Raymond E. Younghans: LATL rail facilities
sources.use: Track connectivity, loops, carhouses and yard layouts.
sources.limits: Explicitly not to scale. Requires independent geographic control; misses later facilities.

sources.label: ERHA LARy route histories and map roster
sources.status: Retrieved 51 line-history pages plus map roster and power-system page; targeted events examined
sources.use: Find changes between snapshots and distinguish rerouting over existing track from construction.
sources.limits: Secondary reconstruction with apparent typos and conflicting closure dates; dates and geometry need corroboration.

sources.label: Metro LARy original company records
sources.use: Construction, divisions/yards/shops, maps/routes, and reports for unresolved early or operational track.
sources.limits: Finding aid is not the underlying documents; many records require archive consultation.

sources.label: Metro: Two Bells employee-news archive
sources.use: Contemporary evidence for construction, openings, abandonment and temporary routings.
sources.limits: Relevant issues must be inspected for each event; presence of an issue is not corroboration.

sources.label: Ed Vandeventer collection inventory
sources.use: Box 8 folders 1, 11 and 12 list route-change notices and operator schedules; potential verification of late track changes.
sources.limits: Underlying notices not retrieved; late geometry remains an explicit gap.

sources.label: Los Angeles DOT records inventory
sources.period: Includes 1915 LARy route map and 1926 fare-zone map
sources.use: Box 53 / CRC 663530 / Special St 85-019 item 1 lists candidate additional maps.
sources.limits: Catalog lead only; not downloaded map geometry.
